children: U.S. offshore oil and gas producer's Q3 revenue beat analyst expectations
Adjusted net income for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company repurchased 1.4 mln shares in Q3
Talos raises full-year 2026 production guidance to 68-70 MBo/d and 92.5-94.5 MBoe/d
Talos lowers 2026 capital expenditure guidance to $475 mln-$525 mln
Company expects Hurricane Isaias to reduce Q4 2026 production by about 7 MBoe/d
HIGHER PRODUCTION - Co said production exceeded guidance due to strong base business performance, no storm downtime, and contributions from acquired assets
OIL PRICE PREMIUM - Co said premium oil realizations above WTI supported margins
NEW WELL CONTRIBUTION - First oil at CPN in Q3 performed in line with expectations
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 8 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil & gas exploration and production peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Talos Energy Inc. is $21.00, about 27.6% above its November 2 closing price of $16.46
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 84 three months ago
